errors.evidence: The image shows a single bar chart with three groups of bars, not three separate charts.
The label on the x-axis is "От всички", not "Общо". While the meaning is similar ("Of all" vs "Total"), it is not the text present in the figure.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите отговори, обозначени с различни цветове според легендата в долната част на диаграмата: "Да" (син цвят), "Не" (жълт цвят), "Не съм решил/а" (зелен цвят) и "Друго" (лилав цвят)
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows the survey groups/time periods ("От всички", "Април 2021 г.", "Август 2021 г."). The answer categories ("Да", "Не", etc.) are represented by the colored bars within each group, as defined by the legend. The description incorrectly swaps the roles of the x-axis and the legend.

errors.evidence: The bars are grouped by the three categories on the x-axis ("От всички", "Април 2021 г.", "Август 2021 г."). Within each of these groups, there are bars for each answer category. The description incorrectly states that the grouping is by answer category.
